market_view: Fed raised rates as expected (Zacks headlines), 10-year yield at a high of 5.0%, dollar up 0.7%; VIX 17.7 is calm but rose 7.6% in 5 days. Hawkish backdrop with no clear one-sided setup.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -3.2% on 09-16 but +20% in 20 days; XOM -3.5% yesterday. Headlines are about VLO, RIG and other names, none about XOM or a supply shock. Driver moves already happened; no named catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Fed hike was expected and is priced in; yields at highs and dollar up work against gold, which is 17% below its high. No NEM headline.

chips.reasoning: CoreWeave Vera Rubin cluster piece (Zacks) is product-deployment promotion, not new guidance or an export rule. Sector ETF -5% in 5 days is not a catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline; pharma items are small biotech noise and market reports. LLY dip alone is not a reason.

copper_uranium.reasoning: No copper supply or China data headline; BWXT nuclear expansion piece mentions CCJ only in passing and is not news for FCX. Copper -5.5% in 5 days with a firm dollar.

would_change_my_mind: A XOM, NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX specific headline (OPEC+ or Hormuz supply shock, NVDA guidance or export rule, LLY trial or pricing decision, copper mine outage or China data).

handoff.what_changed: Three days since the 09-14 note. The Fed raised rates as expected; the 10-year yield hit 5.0% and the dollar rose 0.7%. WTI fell 3.2% on 09-16 and XOM fell 3.5%; the uranium ETF fell 11.7% in 5 days. Headlines were again noise with no named catalyst, so all five families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: WTI drop and rally are priced in; no XOM-specific headline.

gold_miners.why: Expected Fed hike with yields at highs and a firmer dollar; no NEM headline.

chips.why: No NVDA guidance or export-rule headline; CoreWeave Vera Rubin piece is promotion.

pharma.why: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline.

copper_uranium.why: No copper supply or China-data headline for FCX.
